BETA Close X Associated British Foods plc has announced the repurchase of 60,000 of its ordinary shares on July 29, 2026, as part of its ongoing share repurchase program. The average price paid per share was GBp 2076.0640, with the highest price at GBp 2095.0000 and the lowest at GBp 2050.0000. These shares were purchased from Barclays Capital Securities Limited and will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Associated British Foods PLC 29 July 2026 29 July 2026 Associated British Foods plc Transaction in own shares Associated British Foods plc (the " Company ") announces that on 29 July 2026 it purchased for cancellation from Barclays Capital Securities Limited (" Barclays ") the following number of its ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence each pursuant to the authority granted by its shareholders as part of its share repurchase programme, details of which were announced on 25 February 2026. Description of shares: Associated British Foods plc Ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence Date of transaction: 29 July 2026 Number of shares repurchased: 60,000 Average price paid per share: GBp 2076.0640 Highest price paid per share: GBp 2095.0000 Lowest price paid per share: GBp 2050.0000 The Company intends to cancel these Shares. All shares were purchased from Barclays as an on exchange transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. The table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Barclays as part of the buyback programme.
